as_of_content:
[[File:Fallen Titan Hand portrait v3.png|thumb|right]]
==Description==
''Metrotitans were giant, city-sized bots used as ships for the inhabitants of Cybertron millions of years ago. If you find one without a hand, please call Windblade at the EDC base on Caminus.''

==Relic Boosts==
*Increase Commander XP gains by +5% XP.
*In v4.1, this was changed to +5% Attack and Health in all game modes.
==Obtainment==
This relic can be earned upon completing the Legends of Cybertron Rulers of Kaon Special Mission.
